name: Niue
summary: A golden yellow field with the Union Flag in the canton, bearing five yellow stars: one large star in a blue disc at the centre and four small ones on the cross arms.
origin: Niue became self-governing in free association with New Zealand in 1974. The flag was adopted by the Niue Assembly on 15 October 1975.

colors.name: Golden yellow
colors.meaning: The bright sunshine of Niue and the warm feelings of its people toward New Zealand and the world.

symbols.name: Four small stars
symbols.description: On the arms of the St George's cross.
symbols.meaning: The Southern Cross, representing New Zealand.

symbols.name: Large star in a blue disc
symbols.description: At the centre of the Union Flag.
symbols.meaning: Niue itself, self-governing in the Pacific.

facts: It is the only flag with a Union Flag on a yellow field.
Niue, nicknamed 'the Rock', is one of the world's largest coral islands.
Its population is under 2,000, while far more Niueans live in New Zealand.
clues: Yellow with a Union Flag canton holding five yellow stars.
The only flag with a Union Flag on a yellow field.
